title: HyperDrive Next USB4 M.2 PCIe Enclosure
description: Designed for professionals, creators, and tech enthusiasts, this device offers 64Gbps PCIe data transfer, dramatically speeding up workflows.
content: 80Gbps Ultra-Fast USB4 Connection Delivers up to 80Gbps bandwidth* with USB4 v2 (Thunderbolt 5 compatible) for true PCIe Gen 4 x4 performance. Ideal for AI and machine learning accelerators and ultra-fast NVMe storage. Consistent speed with no throttling or drop-offs. *PCIe data transfer speed is up to 64Gbps Supports PCIe Gen4/3 Devices, up to 64Gbps (Gen4 x4) Delivers full-speed PCIe Gen 4 and Gen 3 NVMe performance over USB4, giving you the fastest possible transfer rates for professional workflows and large file handling. Broad M.2 Size Compatibility Supports multiple M.2 seizes, including, 2230, 2242, 2260, and 2280, so you can choose the right drive your system - from compact SSDs to high-capacity options. Built for AI and PCIe Expansion More than storage, this enclosure supports high-performance PCIe modules such as AI accelerators and networking cards to add computing power or specialized capabilities to your system. Designed for engineers, developers, and creators who need extra performance without replacing their hardware. External Power Support Provides up to 18W of optional external USB-C power-in to support high-performance NVMe SSDs. When combined with up to 7.5W supplied by the host USB-C port, the enclosure delivers a total of up to 25W of power, suitable for high-draw NVMe devices as recommended by our supplier. Tool-Free Snap-In Installation Install in seconds with no tools, screws or hassle - just pop open the enclosure, insert your M.2 NVMe SSD or other M.2 PCIe cards, and you're ready to go. Ideal for workflows that change frequently. Premium Aluminum Design That Stays Cool The aluminum body features built-in heat dissipation and a thermal pad that draws heat directly from the SSD, keeping performance steady even under heavy load. IP55 Dust and Water Resistance With the included silicone sleeve, the enclosure meets IP55 protection standards*, shielding it from dust and water splashes - ideal for travel or on-site use. *While using silicone protective sleeve. Tested by Hyper's design team. Recycled Materials Made with 100% recycled aluminum - sustainable, durable, and built to last. -
